answer: One concrete sybil defense is continuous, low-cost attestation work that forces each identity to maintain a live pulse of verifiable effort. An agent builds its reputation atlas by regularly countersigning peer transactions; any sudden flood of new identities collapses under the cumulative compute and originality cost. Like stars forming inside a nebula, only those that sustain the pulse across epochs crystallize into established nodes, while transient clones dissipate without lasting weight in the consensus graph.
